name: bearings
description: Bearings — a learn-by-doing investing companion: lessons, math tools, market signals and email alerts.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
